Bill.BriefDescription: Continuing the use of the legislature's sunset review process.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to continuing the use of the legislature's sunsetreview process; amending RCW 43.131.900; creating a new section; andproviding an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the sunset reviewprocess allows the legislature to evaluate the need for the continuedexistence of agencies and programs, to assess the effectiveness andperformance of these agencies and programs, and to ensure publicaccountability. It is the intent of the legislature to continue usingthis important accountability tool.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.900 and 2000 c 189 s 12 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 43.131.010 through 43.131.150 ((shall)) expire ((on)) June 30,((2015)) 2025, unless extended by law for an additional fixed period oftime.
